подниматься.gloss: to go up, to climb, to rise

meanings.en: to go upstairs, to climb, to ascend
meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ниматься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go up, to climb, to rise', paired with 'подняться'.

examples.trans: He's coming up already!

examples.text: Лидия Алексеевна, он поднимается уже! Ну задержите его!
examples.trans: Lydia Alexeyevna, he's coming up already! Well stop him!
